FOUR SMALL INTERFACES, A LOCAL AND A GATEWAY IMPLEMENTATION EACH (ApiMode.AddApiMode)
GatewayCredentialHandler, the last DelegatingHandler before the network, reads the current
request's token on every HTTP request and replaces whatever the SDK put there. No token:
the call fails before anything is sent. The refusal mapping sits innermost, so a refusal
is never retried, the 429 included: 401 UNAUTHORIZED · 429 RATE_LIMITED · 403 “Model not
allowed” UNKNOWN_MODEL · 403 with no problem type BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.

or scale-out of the Container App loses them.
